email_data_export_ready_body: The export of your OrcAI data is ready. You can download it from your account page until {date}, and then it is deleted.
email_data_export_ready_preview: Your OrcAI data export is ready
email_data_export_ready_subject: Your OrcAI data export is ready
email_instance_admin_granted_body: An admin made you an instance admin of OrcAI. Under Manage instance you can now manage every organisation and user of the instance.
email_instance_admin_granted_preview: You are now an instance admin of OrcAI
email_instance_admin_granted_subject: You are now an instance admin
email_instance_admin_granted_two_factor: This instance requires admins to use two-factor authentication. OrcAI asks you to set it up the next time you open it.
email_instance_admin_revoked_body: An admin removed your instance admin role in OrcAI. Your organisation memberships and roles are unchanged.
email_instance_admin_revoked_preview: You are no longer an instance admin of OrcAI
email_instance_admin_revoked_subject: You are no longer an instance admin
email_instance_role_unexpected: If you did not expect this, tell your admin right away.
email_instance_test_body: You asked OrcAI to send a test email. It arrived, so this instance can deliver email to you.
email_layout_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
email_layout_footer: This message was sent by OrcAI.
email_organization_invited_body: {inviter} invited you to join {organization} with the {role} role. This invitation expires on {date}. If you already have an account, sign in instead and accept the invitation under Switch organisation in the menu with your name.
email_passkey_added_body: A passkey was added to your OrcAI account. It signs you in without your password.
email_passkey_added_preview: A passkey was added to your OrcAI account
email_passkey_added_subject: A passkey was added to your account
email_reset_password_body: Use this link to choose a new password. If you did not request this, you can ignore this message.
email_security_unexpected: If this was not you, change your password right away and tell your admin.
email_two_factor_disabled_body: Two-factor authentication was turned off for your OrcAI account. Signing in now needs only your password.
email_two_factor_disabled_preview: Two-factor authentication is off for your OrcAI account
email_two_factor_reset_body: An admin reset two-factor authentication for your OrcAI account, removed your passkeys and signed you out everywhere. Sign in with your password and set them up again.
email_two_factor_reset_preview: An admin reset two-factor authentication for your OrcAI account
email_verify_body: Confirm that this email address belongs to you to finish setting up your OrcAI account.
